name: MonarchAiModeSwitcher
title: AiModeSwitcher
summary: Switches how the assistant works (Ask, Edit, Agent by default) with the selected mode's description underneath, so the consequence of the choice is always visible.
whenToUse: In a prompt toolbar or an assistant panel, when the assistant can work in two to five modes that change what it may do.
whenNotToUse: For views or filters of the same content use the Material 3 segmented buttons on their own (SegmentedControl). For more than five modes or long descriptions use MonarchRadioCardGroup. For the writing tone use MonarchAiTonePicker.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiModeSwitcher(selection: String, onSelectionChange: (String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, modes: List<MonarchAiMode> = MonarchAiMode.defaults(), size: MonarchAiModeSwitcherSize = MonarchAiModeSwitcherSize.Sm, enabled: Boolean = true, showDescription: Boolean = true, label: String? = null)
class MonarchAiMode(id: String, label: String, description: String? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, iconOnly: Boolean = false, enabled: Boolean = true)

options.name: selection
options.description: The id of the selected mode. An id that matches no mode selects nothing.

options.name: onSelectionChange
options.description: Called with the id of the mode the user chose. Never called for a disabled mode or the mode already selected.

options.name: modes
options.description: The modes, two to five: each with an id, a label, an optional description, an optional decorative icon, iconOnly and enabled. The defaults are Ask, Edit and Agent (ids ask, edit, agent) with built-in descriptions.

options.name: size
options.description: Sm: the label type and tighter padding, for a prompt toolbar. Md: the body type and the Material 3 padding.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the user can change the mode, for example false while a response runs.

options.name: showDescription
options.description: Whether the selected mode's description is shown under the control. Turn it off when it is shown elsewhere.

options.name: label
options.description: Replaces the TalkBack name of the choice, "Mode" (monarch_aimodeswitcher_label).

states.name: selected
states.description: The selected segment takes the Material 3 selected fill from MonarchTheme and the check mark; its description is shown underneath.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Every segment is disabled and the description uses the disabled text color.

states.name: mode disabled
states.description: That segment is disabled and choosing it does not change the selection.

states.name: no description
states.description: When no mode has a description, or showDescription is false, there is no description line.

appearance: The Material 3 segmented buttons as MonarchTheme colors them, full width, with the description in the caption type and the muted text color underneath. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web builds on Monarch's SegmentedControl and iOS on the system segmented Picker; Android uses the Material 3 single-choice segmented buttons, which show a check mark on the selected segment. A mode's icon is a composable slot (iOS takes an SF Symbol name) and shows before the label on segments that are not selected, because Material 3 puts the check mark in that place on the selected one. The built-in Ask, Edit and Agent modes match iOS; the web has no defaults. Disabling the whole switcher is the enabled parameter. The description is a polite live region, where iOS posts an announcement.
accessibility: The segments are radio buttons in a selectable group with the content description "Mode", replaceable with label; TalkBack reads each one's position and selected state.
Each segment has a 48dp touch target, from Material 3.
The selected segment shows a check mark as well as its fill, so the choice does not rest on color.
The description line is a polite live region, so TalkBack reads the new mode's description after a switch.
An icon-only segment is read as the mode's label; other icons are decorative and hidden from TalkBack.
Segment labels and the description wrap at large font sizes.
edgeCases: A selection that matches no mode leaves no segment selected and shows an empty description line.
A mode with no description shows an empty line while another mode has one, so the layout does not jump.
With more than five modes the segments become too narrow for their labels; use a radio card group instead.

examples.title: With descriptions
examples.template:
MonarchAiModeSwitcher(
    selection = mode,
    onSelectionChange = { mode = it },
    modes = listOf(
        MonarchAiMode({{modes.0.id}}, {{modes.0.label}}, {{modes.0.description}}),
        MonarchAiMode({{modes.1.id}}, {{modes.1.label}}, {{modes.1.description}}),
        MonarchAiMode({{modes.2.id}}, {{modes.2.label}}, {{modes.2.description}}),
    ),
)
examples.code:
MonarchAiModeSwitcher(
    selection = mode,
    onSelectionChange = { mode = it },
    modes = listOf(
        MonarchAiMode("ask", "Ask", "Answers questions. Changes nothing."),
        MonarchAiMode("edit", "Edit", "Proposes edits you review before they apply."),
        MonarchAiMode("agent", "Agent", "Works through steps and uses tools. Asks before anything risky."),
    ),
)

examples.title: Own modes, without the description
examples.code:
MonarchAiModeSwitcher(
    selection = mode,
    onSelectionChange = { mode = it },
    modes = listOf(
        MonarchAiMode("research", "Research", "Reads sources and cites them."),
        MonarchAiMode("write", "Write", "Drafts text for you to edit."),
    ),
    size = MonarchAiModeSwitcherSize.Md,
    showDescription = false,
)
